title: Targeted Learning for Externally Controlled Trials and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2611.28421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper focuses on externally controlled trials (ECTs), which consist of a single-arm clinical trial supplemented by an external control arm (ECA). Potential data sources for the ECA can be broadly classified into three categories: (i) the control arm of a historical clinical trial, (ii) a concurrent cohort study, and (iii) external real-world data (RWD). In this paper, we consider a broad class of estimands defined through balancing weights. For a given estimand in the class, we discuss the efficient influence function (EIF) and the targeted maximum likelihood estimator (TMLE), together with practical implementation algorithms. Within the targeted learning framework, TMLE is a substitution estimator that enjoys several desirable theoretical properties and favorable finite-sample performance. translated_title: 外部对照试验及更广泛场景的靶向学习
translated_abstract: 本文聚焦于外部对照试验（ECT），即由单臂临床试验辅以外部对照臂（ECA）构成的试验设计。外部对照臂的潜在数据来源可大致分为三类：(i) 历史临床试验的对照组，(ii) 同期队列研究，以及 (iii) 外部真实世界数据（RWD）。本文考虑了一类通过平衡权重定义的广泛的估计对象（estimands）。针对该类中给定的估计对象，我们讨论了有效影响函数（EIF）与靶向最大似然估计量（TMLE），并给出了实用的实现算法。在靶向学习框架内，TMLE 是一种替代估计量，具有多项理想的理论性质和良好的有限样本表现。最后，所提出的框架被扩展到另外两种场景：(1) 辅以外部协变量信息的随机对照试验（RCT）……
tldr: 本文针对外部对照试验提出了基于平衡权重的靶向学习框架，给出有效影响函数与靶向最大似然估计量（TMLE）及其实用算法，并将该框架扩展到辅以外部协变量的随机对照试验等更多场景。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a targeted learning framework based on balancing weights for externally controlled trials, providing the efficient influence function and TMLE with practical algorithms, and extends the framework to settings such as randomized controlled trials augmented with external covariates.
